title: 第22章仪式第23章 晚安
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
因斯·赞格威尔试图通过灵性联系去感知、去操控羽毛笔，却感觉自己的意念如同撞上了一堵无形的、坚不可摧的墙壁！
不仅无法驱动羽毛笔，甚至连他与这件封印物之间那紧密的联系，都在这一刻变得模糊、滞涩起来！
他整个人，连同那支拥有着可怕力量的羽毛笔，如同化作了雕像，僵硬地定格在书桌前。
下一瞬间，更让因斯·赞格威尔头皮发麻、脊背发凉的事情发生了。
那张刚刚书写着“剧本”的纸张上，所有的墨迹，所有的单词，包括他刚刚写下的关于邓恩污染、关于“学徒”死亡、一切一切句子……开始如同被水浸染一般，迅速变得模糊、淡化，然后……消失了！
仿佛被某种规则层面的力量，直接从“存在”的概念上抹去一般！
仅仅一两秒的功夫，整张纸上变得一片空白，仿佛从未被书写过任何东西。
不，并非完全空白。
在纸张的正中央，还残留着一个单词——“学徒”。
“学徒”一个单词孤零零地停留在那里，显得异常突兀和诡异。
紧接着，在因斯·赞格威尔惊恐的注视下，那“学徒”开始扭曲、变形！
它们不再遵循任何已知的字体结构，如同活物般蠕动、拉伸、交织，最终化作了无数个大小不一、形态各异的、墨迹淋漓的——“门”！
这些“门”慢慢布满了整张空白的纸页，密密麻麻，仿佛无数只窥探的眼睛，又像是通往无数未知维度的入口。
它们缓缓旋转、移动，散发出一种令人心智混乱的空间错乱感。
因斯·赞格威尔只觉得自己的大脑一阵刺痛，灵性在疯狂预警，告诉他正在发生极其可怕、远超他理解范围的事情！
他想移开目光，想毁掉这张纸，却发现自己的身体依旧处于那种诡异的凝滞状态，连一根手指都无法动弹！
然后，那遍布纸页的、无数的“门”，仿佛受到了某种统一的召唤，开始相互吸引、碰撞、融合！
它们汇聚到一起，墨迹翻涌，最终形成了一个巨大、深邃、仿佛能吞噬一切光线的漆黑墨点。
这个墨点，缓缓地、违背物理规律地，从平坦的纸面上“浮”了起来，悬浮在因斯·赞格威尔面前的半空中，缓缓旋转着，散发出冰冷、死寂的气息。
因斯·赞格威尔的瞳孔慢慢收缩，无边的恐惧攫住了他的心脏。

他想要尖叫，想要反抗，想要逃离，却发不出任何声音，做不出任何动作。
他只能眼睁睁地看着，那个悬浮的、仿佛蕴含着无数“门”之概念的漆黑墨点，在下一瞬间，如同出膛的子弹，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，猛地冲向他的额头！
“嘭——！”
并非物理层面的撞击声，而是直接响彻于灵体、响彻于意识最深处的、如同宇宙初开般的轰鸣！
因斯·赞格威尔只觉得自己的脑袋仿佛被一柄无形的巨锤狠狠砸中，又像是被强行塞进了无数扇疯狂开合的空间之门，剧烈的、难以形容的痛苦瞬间淹没了他的所有感知。
他眼前一黑，所有的思绪、所有的意识，如同退潮般迅速消散。
他身体一软，彻底失去了知觉，重重地向后倒去，撞翻了椅子，发出一声沉闷的响声。
那悬浮的墨点在一击之后，也如同完成了使命般，悄然消散，没有留下任何痕迹。
房间内，重新恢复了寂静。
只有那盏油灯依旧在摇曳，映照着倒在地上的因斯·赞格威尔，以及书桌上那张变得完全空白、仿佛什么都未曾发生过的纸张。
content_en:
Ince Zangwill tried to perceive and control the quill through spiritual connection, but he felt as if his thoughts had hit an invisible and indestructible wall!
Not only was he unable to drive the quill, but even the close connection between him and this sealed object became blurred and stagnant at this moment!
His whole body, together with the quill that possessed terrifying power, seemed to have turned into a statue, frozen stiffly in front of the desk.
The next moment, something happened that made Ince Zangwill's scalp numb and his spine shivers.
On the paper on which the "script" had just been written, all the ink stains and words, including the sentences he had just written about Dunn's pollution, about the death of the "apprentice", everything... began to seem like being soaked in water, quickly became blurred, faded, and then... disappeared!
It's as if it was directly wiped away from the concept of "existence" by some kind of rule-level power!
In just a second or two, the entire paper became blank, as if nothing had ever been written on it.
No, it's not completely blank.
In the center of the paper, there is still a word - "apprentice".
The word "apprentice" stayed there alone, looking extremely abrupt and strange.
Then, under the horrified gaze of Ince Zangwill, the "apprentice" began to twist and deform!
They no longer follow any known font structure, but squirm, stretch, and interweave like living creatures, eventually turning into countless ink-stained "doors" of different sizes and shapes!
These "doors" slowly filled the entire blank page, densely packed, like countless prying eyes, and like entrances to countless unknown dimensions.
They slowly rotate and move, emitting a sense of spatial dislocation that confuses the mind.
Ince Zangwill felt a stabbing pain in his brain, and his spirituality was giving a frantic warning, telling him that something extremely terrible and far beyond the scope of his understanding was happening!
He wanted to look away and destroy the paper, but found that his body was still in that weird stagnant state, and he couldn't even move a finger!
Then, the countless "doors" spread across the page seemed to be summoned by some kind of unity, and began to attract, collide, and merge with each other!
They came together, and the ink swelled, eventually forming a huge, deep, dark ink spot that seemed to be able to swallow all light.
This ink dot, slowly and against the laws of physics, "floated" from the flat paper, suspended in mid-air in front of Ince Zangwill, slowly rotating, exuding a cold, dead atmosphere.
Ince Zangwill's pupils slowly shrank, and boundless fear seized his heart.
He wanted to scream, resist, and escape, but he couldn't make any sound or move.
He could only watch helplessly as the suspended black ink dots, which seemed to contain the concepts of countless "doors", rushed towards his forehead like a bullet from the barrel at lightning speed!
"Bang——!"
It is not a collision on the physical level, but a roar that directly resounds through the spirit body and the deepest part of consciousness, like the beginning of the universe!
Ince Zangwill felt as if his head had been hit hard by an invisible giant hammer, and as if he had been forced into countless space doors that opened and closed crazily. The severe and indescribable pain instantly overwhelmed all his senses.
His eyes went dark, and all his thoughts and consciousness quickly dissipated like an ebbing tide.
His body went limp and he completely lost consciousness. He fell back heavily, knocking over the chair and making a dull sound.
After one blow, the suspended ink dots quietly dissipated as if they had completed their mission, leaving no trace behind.
Silence returned to the room.
Only the oil lamp is still flickering, reflecting Ince Zangwill who fell on the ground, and the paper on the desk that became completely blank, as if nothing had happened.
